content.short: EverRise provides security and multi-chain DeFi solutions and dapps across multiple networks.
content.description: EverRise is a blockchain technology company delivering security and multi-chain solutions for DeFi protocols. It offers a suite of decentralized applications (dapps) designed for use on multiple networks to broaden access to DeFi and equip developers with tools to adapt to the evolving space. EverRise helps project teams close gaps by providing the tools they need to build sustainable, long-term success for their projects.
